about: The store's cases (berry/panel_store.be), run by berry/test/test_panel_store.be: written by hand, with what each must answer. Scenarios start from a fresh copy of fixtures/living-room.json, and the document must still validate after every scenario.

placement.about: The Living room, created in a fixed order, on its own matrix of 8 × 5 cells, which the EU's 11 × 5 and the US's 8 × 8 take as it is. A size is [cols, rows]; each step places a block of that size by the reading-order rule and must land where the croqui has it.

a full zone takes no more
a hall lamp takes another place, one of its own
a single-slot swap asks first
a slot outside the grid is refused
the Hall's lamps swap places like any other (one device, one place)
moving a lamp to a zone with room
a move to a full zone is refused
deleting a zone deletes its devices
the home screen stays
a screen with zones stays
an empty screen can go
the plan has no room left
a grid bigger than the matrix
a relay device from the +: the zone's next place, the first relay:k free, and none on a relay that powers Zigbee devices
the Hall's card switches relay 1 only while all that hangs on it is in the Hall
a lamp powered by relay 2 has no power while it is open, each on its own
a relay is 1 or 2, a relay device always has one, and a relay holds one kind of device
removing a relay device takes it from the store, and nothing leaves the network
relinking a button clears its marks
a zone in its group is one command
a zone without power is skipped

a joining lamp falls back to a direct command

placementUS.about: The Living room built on a matrix of 5 × 8 cells, the US's until 2026-09-24, the tall ones first: in this order the reading-order rule lands every card where the turned croqui has it (fixtures/living-room-us.json), with no tap on the dashed card.

turn.about: fixtures/living-room-us.json is fixtures/living-room.json turned a quarter clockwise, written by hand. fitMatrix fits a configuration to the panel it is on: it takes the panel's matrix when its cards fit (the Living room, 8 x 5, on the EU's 11 x 5 and the US's 8 x 8), turns it when they only fit turned, and refuses otherwise. The value is the turn: 1 clockwise, -1 counterclockwise, 0 none.

shapes.about: Cards of irregular shape. Two cards on an 8 x 5 plan, a cell at 2,2 and a column of three at 1,5; holesAt is a block [col,row,cols,rows] and its holes [dc,dr], in one piece or in several, or the refusal; ghostTo a free cell touched, the dashed card's [cols,rows] and where it goes; ghostResized the dashed card and the grid typed, [cols,rows], cut at the plan's edge.

shapesAtTheEdge.about: A plan that once showed a defect: 11 x 5 cells, a card at columns 0 to 7 of rows 0 to 2, and one at columns 8 and 9 of row 1. The dashed card at 8,0: 4x4 typed is cut to three columns, around the second card, and never moved back over the first; 3x2 is two pieces.
